branch_activations.carrier: خَفَّتْ carries the low measured-share side of the focus verdict.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The atom-weight and mustard-seed deed contexts in 99:7, 99:8, and 31:16.
branch_activations.activation: Small-unit accounting gives the low-share branch a concrete scale of visibility and deficit.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Lightness can mean insufficient counted accumulation while small acts remain present.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is used for measured share, not literal population size.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sayısı veya ölçülen payı az olmak
branch_activations.facet_statement: Tartıyla gösterilen payın azlığı, ölçülen iyi işlerin az olmasına işaret eder.
branch_activations.carrier: خَفَّتْ carries the measured-share facet.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The atom-weighted good and evil deed contexts in 99:7 and 99:8.
branch_activations.activation: The smallest-unit triggers make the scale's low result a matter of accumulated accountable content.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The deficit is in the balance of countable deeds, not in the visibility of small deeds.
branch_activations.boundary: The connection does not determine how deeds are aggregated.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: toplumsal değer; eksiksiz ağırlıktaki para
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kimsenin toplum içindeki önemi, değeri veya saygınlığı ağırlık düşüncesiyle değerlendirilir.
branch_activations.carrier: مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ carries value through the idea of weight.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The atom-weight justice and mustard-seed value connections in 4:40 and 31:16.
branch_activations.activation: The scale's value facet meets smallest-unit accountability and keeps significance attached to measured content.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Low registered standing is a deficient result within a system that can still recognize the minute.
branch_activations.boundary: The value branch does not decide whether the scales are deeds, records, or instruments.

findings.title: A live counter-reading of lightness
findings.claim: The wider field keeps a capacity and mobility reading of lightness alive: a load can be made easier or a person can move lightly, even as this focus frame turns lightness into deficient judgment.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier خَفَّتْ meets the light/heavy capacity context in 9:41 and the portable-load context in 16:80; the contrast makes the local scale frame's adverse direction newly visible without suppressing the counter-reading.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can distinguish the focus's judged lightness from the valid wider sense of lightness as readiness or ease of carrying.
findings.containment: The capacity reading is counter-evidence and boundary, not the selected meaning of this scale verdict; both directions remain recoverable.

epistemic.reason: The connection records supply exact target Arabic and explicitly describe a nonjudicial capacity parallel, but target morphology is not supplied.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ağırlığın veya yükün az olması ve azaltılması
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin ağırlığı veya taşıdığı yük, ağır olma durumuna göre azdır.
branch_activations.carrier: خَفَّتْ carries ordinary low-weight and easing pressure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The light/heavy capacity contrast in 9:41 and the portable-load context in 16:80.
branch_activations.activation: The wider positive capacity contexts show the lexical alternative against which the focus judgment is bounded.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Lightness remains capable of meaning readiness or easier carrying elsewhere, while here it is measured as deficit.
branch_activations.boundary: The counter-reading does not displace the focus's adverse scale setting.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ağırlığın veya yükün az olması ve azaltılması
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişinin durumu, yükü veya eşyası az güç gerektirecek ölçüde kolaylaşabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: خَفَّتْ carries the ease-of-load facet as a live wider possibility.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The capacity and portable-burden contexts in 9:41 and 16:80.
branch_activations.activation: The independent contexts distinguish ordinary easing from the focus's evaluative lightness.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The local verdict is specifically a failure under weighing, not a denial of the wider ease sense.
branch_activations.boundary: This is retained as counter-evidence and does not introduce a positive outcome into 101:8.

findings.title: Plural scales open a comprehensive record
findings.claim: The plural scale noun can open the judgment toward several instruments, criteria, or records whose accounting leaves even small and great items within view.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ meets the no-omission record context in 18:49; plurality and comprehensive inventory then sharpen the scale image without fixing one concrete form for the scales.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the plural can matter: lightness belongs to a field of assessment broad enough to register what is being counted.
findings.containment: The packet does not choose between instruments, criteria, records, or repeated acts; this finding preserves those live alternatives rather than treating one as established.

epistemic.reason: The connection supplies a medium-strength inventory parallel and exact target Arabic, but it is indirect and target morphology is unavailable.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: tartı aracı ve adil değerlendirme ölçütü
branch_activations.facet_statement: Nesnelerin ağırlığını belirlemeye yarayan tartı aracı ve onun ölçü birimleri söz konusudur.
branch_activations.carrier: مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ carries a plural field of measuring instruments.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The record in 18:49 that leaves no small or great item uncounted.
branch_activations.activation: The comprehensive-record trigger gives the plural scale noun an expanded inventory pressure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The light result can belong to a broad accounting field rather than one isolated weighing event.
branch_activations.boundary: The trigger does not establish that the scales are literally a written book or specify their number.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: tartı aracı ve adil değerlendirme ölçütü
branch_activations.facet_statement: Tartı düşüncesi, insanların yaptıklarını ve haklarını adil ve denk biçimde değerlendirmeye aktarılır.
branch_activations.carrier: مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ carries the evaluative criteria field.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The no-omission accountability record in 18:49.
branch_activations.activation: The record context makes plural criteria and comprehensive judgment newly perceptible through the focus scale noun.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Lightness is a deficient result within an evaluation that can retain the whole inventory.
branch_activations.boundary: The finding keeps instruments, criteria, and records as alternatives rather than selecting one.

friction_notes: All 23 docket candidates were reviewed exactly once; no focus-word bridge is unresolved (5 of 5 words resolved).

The HFT source is present and visible, but all 11 assigned HFT records have zero supplied and zero cited anchor evidence. They therefore remain rejected as findings rather than being silently promoted; their unresolved possibilities are not treated as established readings.

The packet has no selected_context_units. Context claims therefore use only explicit context ayah refs in analysis_context and exact target ayah evidence carried by connection records; connection rows explicitly lack target morphology and lexical analysis.

The reader-B aggregate contains three registered nominated context branches without addressable carrier occurrences and four unresolved branch citations (ء م م/B012, ق ر ع/B010, ن و س/B001, ه و ي/B002); the registered focus branches survive with contextual boundaries, while those nominations are excluded.

The live capacity reading is retained as counter-evidence so the adverse focus frame is not mistaken for a universal gloss of lightness. The proportion, smallest-deed, and plural-record readings are connection-backed but remain qualified or exploratory and are not ranked.

No separate semantic_obligations array or exact obligation refs are supplied in the packet; all semantic_obligation_exclusions and semantic_obligation_refs are therefore empty rather than inventing identifiers.
